description: Static weights of STANDARD v1.1.0 section 8.3. Evidence from an item whose sender's identity has a trust class weighs the class weight; when the evidence also has a source type, the lower of the class weight and the source weight applies. A domain profile overrides a class weight with the trust_weights key trust_class:<class>, kept apart from source keys of the same name. The Standard states the class override only. That any other trust_weights key is the weight of the source it names, replacing the model's weight for that source or weighing a source the model does not name, rests on the comment on trust_classes in schemas/authority_trust_model.yaml (a profile's trust_weights 'may override any class, as it may any source') and on the description of trust_weights in schemas/profiles/profile_schema.yaml; the vectors that depend on it say so. `model` holds the weights of schemas/authority_trust_model.yaml that the vectors read. `not_covered` lists the cases the vectors leave out because the Standard does not state their result, each with what the reference implementation does; a vector for one of them would make one reading look required. grounded_agency/trust.py is the reference implementation; tests/test_trust.py runs it against this file.

fields.name: The vector's name, unique in this file.
fields.source_type: The source type of the evidence. Absent: it has none.
fields.trust_class: The trust class of the identity of the item's sender. Absent: the evidence has none.
fields.profile_trust_weights: The trust_weights of the domain profile in force. Absent: no profile.
fields.weight: The expected static weight. A conforming value differs from it by at most `tolerance`.

not_covered: A source type that has no weight in the model or the profile, a trust class the model does not have, and evidence with neither. Section 8 does not say what they weigh. The reference implementation refuses each.

A profile key trust_class:<class> for a class the model does not have. Section 8.3 says the classes are exactly those of agent_identity.trust_class. The reference implementation does not read such a key as adding a class, and refuses evidence of that class.

vectors.name: source_type_alone
vectors.about: Evidence with a source type and no trust class weighs the source weight.

vectors.name: trust_class_alone
vectors.about: Evidence with a trust class and no source type weighs the class weight.

vectors.name: class_lower_than_source
vectors.about: The lower of the two applies: a trusted channel cannot lift an untrusted sender.

vectors.name: source_lower_than_class
vectors.about: The lower of the two applies when the source weight is the lower one.

vectors.name: profile_overrides_a_class
vectors.about: The profile key trust_class:peer_agent replaces the class weight.

vectors.name: profile_overrides_a_source
vectors.about: The profile key primary_api replaces the source weight. Rests on the schema comment, not on the Standard's text.

vectors.name: profile_names_its_own_source
vectors.about: The model has no weight for user_calendar; the profile gives it one, as the shipped profiles do for their own sources. Rests on the profile schema's description of trust_weights, not on the Standard's text.

vectors.name: raised_class_still_bounded_by_source
vectors.about: The profile raises the class weight to 0.9; the source weight, 0.65, is now the lower.

vectors.name: lowered_class_bounds_the_source
vectors.about: The profile lowers the class weight to 0.4, below the source weight of 0.95.

vectors.name: source_key_does_not_override_the_class
vectors.about: system_of_record names a source type and a trust class. The profile key system_of_record is the source key: the class weight stays 0.92.

vectors.name: class_key_does_not_override_the_source
vectors.about: The profile key trust_class:system_of_record is the class key: the source weight stays 0.92.

vectors.name: both_keys_of_one_name
vectors.about: The profile overrides the source to 0.6 and the class to 0.8; the lower applies. The source override rests on the schema comment, not on the Standard's text.

vectors.name: unrelated_profile_keys
vectors.about: Profile keys for other sources and classes change nothing.
